description: Use this when the user plays a 5-letter word guessing game with green/yellow/gray feedback and wants the remaining possible answers or a strong next guess (word game solver, guess helper). Takes previous guesses with their color feedback (G/Y/-), applies the standard repeated-letter rules, counts the words still possible and lists up to 60 of them, and ranks next guesses by expected information. Supports 4-8 letter variants and hard mode. Does not know today's answer and does not play the game. Do not use for unscrambling letters or crossword patterns.

guesses.description: Guesses made so far with their color feedback, in order, e.g. [{"word":"CRANE","feedback":"-Y--G"}]. Leave empty for a suggested opening guess.

feedback.description: One mark per letter: G = green (right letter, right spot), Y = yellow (in the word, wrong spot), - = gray (not in the word), e.g. GY--G. Colored squares like 🟩🟨⬛ also work.

hard_mode.description: true if every next guess must use all revealed clues (hard mode); then only words that could still be the answer are suggested.

word_length.description: Letters in the hidden word, e.g. 5 (default: length of the guesses, else 5).

name: solve_word_guess
title: Narrow down a word guess
